West; Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 2008, Vol. 94, No. 4, 672–695; DOI 10.1037/0022-3514.94.4.672 printed on first page. This is primary article text, with methods/results/tables and references through p. 695, not merely an abstract. No PDF supplied. Experiment 8 and article page 14 (printed p. 685) match the locator, but the neutral description does not name the task. Two plausible comparisons remain; no selection by numeric agreement or input order. Candidate A: modus ponens no-belief-bias versus some-belief-bias, printed Cohen’s d 0.302, t(379) = 2.91, p < .01; participant groups 159 and 222, arithmetic 159 + 222 = 381. Candidate B: four-card selection correct versus incorrect, printed Cohen’s d 0.493, t(373) = 4.40, p < .001; explicit task sample 375. These are candidates only and have not been promoted to core value fields. Additional continuous analyses on the same page are not interchangeable with these comparisons. Unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders only.
